BrochureContent.Content:
Detached bungalow on a large private site (0.58 Hectare/ 1.4 Acre) with mature trees and landscaping in a country setting within minutes of Cork City. The property is easily accessed from the N22 Ballincollig By-Pass Junction 2.

This property is perfect for a family looking for the peaceful country lifestyle while being minutes from all the amenities of Ballincollig and Cork City. Farran Forrest Park, National Rowing Centre and the Lee Valley Golf Club are all just a short drive.

The three bedroom bungalow was constructed in late 1990’s and offers an opportunity for a most beautiful home in an ideal location embracing both country and city living.  New owners will easily put their stamp on it and may, with planning permission, wish to extend to embrace this wonderful site. 

For avid gardeners this site offers huge potential as the beautiful mature trees will form the perfect backdrop to additional planting and landscaping.



Accommodation
Living Room 4.3m x 4.73m
Family Room 5.64m x 3.41m
Kitchen 2.92m x 3.4m
Utility 2.12m x 2.66m
Primary Bedroom 4.13m x 3.38m + Walk-in Wardrobe and 1 Ensuite
Bedroom 2: 4.24m x 3.38m
Bedroom 3: 2.86m x 4.49m 
Bathroom: 1.95m 3.41m
Floor Area: 127m2
See Floor Plans and Video for full details.

Detached Garage. 
This is ideal to use as a studio or home office.

Services: Deep Bored Well, Septic Tank, Gas Central Heating.  PVC Double Glazed Windows.

Viewing is recommended.
